# Duct

> Duct is a B2B SaaS tool that synthesizes data across product, marketing, and sales tools into weekly intelligence briefs and real-time alerts — no SQL, no dashboards required.

Duct is designed for product managers, growth leads, and marketing teams at 20–200 person SaaS companies who need cross-tool insights without manual work or data engineering.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://getduct.ai/): Overview of Duct — what it does, who it's for, and how to join the early access waitlist.
- [For Product Intelligence](https://getduct.ai/for-product-intelligence): How Duct connects Mixpanel, Intercom, Linear, and Salesforce into a daily PM brief with cross-tool correlations and anomaly alerts.
- [For Organic Growth](https://getduct.ai/for-organic-growth): How Duct surfaces SEO and content performance signals from Search Console, Ahrefs, and GA4 into a weekly action brief.
- [Blog](https://getduct.ai/blog/): Articles on product intelligence, SEO strategy, and growth analytics for SaaS teams.
